params.name: query
params.description: Product name to search for (e.g., "basecamp", "slack", "notion"). URL-encode spaces and special characters.

params.name: api_key
params.description: Your SaaSHub API key. Obtain from https://www.saashub.com/profile/api_key

items.docs: Returns data for the first software product matching the query string. Returns product details including name, tagline, SaaSHub URL, pricing, categories, and basic metadata.
